why: Truist's 2026 call schedule (IR, 2025-05-01) and its 2026-09-18 release both set the Q3 results before the open on Friday 2026-10-16, with a call at 08:00 ET. This is the first print under CEO Mike Lyons (from 2026-09-01).

where_to_look: Any strategic reset by the new CEO Mike Lyons (efficiency target, repositioning, buyback cadence): his September conference remarks (Barclays Global Financial Services, mid-September) and 8-Ks since 2026-09-01. A first-print kitchen-sink or new targets is the thing that would not be in the model.
Deposit mix shift: the largest headwind behind the Q2 NII guide cut. Compare Fed H.8 large-bank deposit data for Q3 against the guide of ~+1.5% Q3 NII.
Read-across from JPM/WFC/PNC/USB prints earlier this week on deposit costs and loan spreads.
The skew is steep: 25-delta skew 7.97 vol points and put/call OI 1.68, the most downside-paid name in the window. Look for what the put buyers are hedging.
